name: INDUSTRIAL BASEMENT WALL
text: Stark concrete block walls enclose the
machinery, showing water stains and patching
from decades of industrial use.

name: LOWER WALKWAY FENCING
text: Metal railing sections off the lower floor
grating, meant to keep workers from wandering
into the coolant trenches.

name: GLOWING COOLANT TRENCH
text: A deep trench channels bright, viscous fluid
through the facility, emitting a harsh, cold
luminescence.

name: VENTILATION UNIT FENCING
text: Sturdy railings surround the humming condenser
units, bolted firmly into the concrete floor.

name: RUSTED DRAINAGE PIPE
text: This corroded lower pipe bends down toward the
grate, meant to discharge overflow or
byproducts from the main assembly.

name: TARNISHED COPPER PIPING
text: These thin pipes run from the pressure dials
down toward the pump assembly, their copper
finish dull and oxidized.

name: GRATED FLUID PIT
text: A heavy metal grate covers a shallow pit,
illuminated from below by the same harsh,
glowing coolant found in the trench.

name: STORAGE CORNER JUNK
text: Scrap metal, disused containers, and assorted
debris have been piled haphazardly in this
dark, neglected corner.

name: FLUID TRANSFER LINES
text: A pair of small, parallel pipes run
horizontally along the wall, showing distinct
signs of rust near the joints.

name: TOOL STORAGE RACK
text: A pegboard holds a variety of heavy wrenches
and a hammer, organized for routine
maintenance of the pump equipment.

name: LOWER ACCESS DOORWAY
text: A simple metal frame marks an open doorway
leading further into the damp, noisy
substructure.

name: CLUTTERED WORK STATION
text: A small table is covered in loose wire, scraps
of paper, and an old crate, illuminated by a
warm work light.

name: LOWER CONNECTION PIPES
text: Two narrow pipes emerge from the pump housing,
bending down to run parallel beneath the main
machinery.

name: DIAGNOSTIC TERMINAL STATION
text: A bulky, gray console sits against the far
wall, its single screen glowing a pale, steady
cyan.
